title: aldama obtusifolia
intro: Aldama obtusifolia, commonly known as Mexican tea, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents of Aldama obtusifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
